biggest_catch: Screeners are unpaid, and some studies use researcher-distributed incentives with longer timelines (UserTesting-branded studies pay at 14 days).
catches: Unpaid screener applications: only selected participants earn.
Some researchers distribute incentives themselves with longer, study-specific timelines (always shown before you apply).
UserTesting-branded studies pay via digital gift card 14 days after completion.
Incentive type varies (gift cards, cash, PayPal, Visa gift card) and is shown on the study details page before you apply.
No-pay guarantee for incomplete or non-compliant participation.

c2.evidence: Userinterviews.com official support: 'Most incentives are issued within a day or two of a session. However, researchers have up to 10 business days after the completed session to release payment.'

c3.evidence: Free participant account; no upfront fee documented.

c4.evidence: Official pay ($50–$150 across listed studies), official timing (day or two; up to 10 business days), official durations (45–70 minutes).

eligibility: Create a free User Interviews account; apply to studies; pass screeners and be selected by the researcher.
maximize: User Interviews is repeatable and officially documented: listings state exact incentives and durations before you apply. Apply fast - popular studies fill quickly - and keep your profile complete; researchers select from screener answers. Expect most incentives within a day or two of the session, with a 10-business-day backstop. UserTesting-branded studies pay at 14 days.
notes: Pay and duration come from UserInterviews' own study listings; timing from their official incentive-payments support article. Repeatable: thousands of studies posted monthly.
numeric_basis: Official listings: $50/≤45 min and $150/60–70 min; official timing: day or two, up to 10 business days after session
payout_quote: Official listings: 'you will be compensated $50' for a study taking 'no more than 45 minutes'; 'You will be compensated a total of $150' for tasks taking 'around 60-70 minutes total'. Official support: 'Most incentives are issued within a day or two of a session.'
payout_value_note: $50-$150 per completed study per User Interviews' own study listings

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per study; unpaid screeners and no selection mean no pay

s6.note: Official concrete pay, timing, and session time verified.

steps: Create a free User Interviews account and complete your profile.
Browse studies and apply through their screening questions.
Be selected by the researcher and complete the session.
Receive your incentive within a day or two (researchers have up to 10 business days) after the session.
timing: Official: 'Most incentives are issued within a day or two of a session. However, researchers have up to 10 business days after the completed session to release payment.'
who_pays: The researcher funds the incentive, and it's issued to you - usually through Tremendous as gift cards, cash, PayPal, or a Visa gift card. The exact amount and incentive type are shown on each study listing before you apply.
who_qualifies: Create a free User Interviews account, apply to studies, pass the study's screener questions, and be selected by the researcher.
work_available: Studies post and fill fast - popular ones go quickly. Screener applications are unpaid and you only earn if you're selected, so volume depends on your demographics and how fast you apply.
what_gets_accepted: Completed, compliant sessions confirmed by the researcher. Incomplete or non-compliant participation has no pay guarantee.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No upfront fee. Screener applications are unpaid. The researcher has up to 10 business days after the completed session to release payment, and UserTesting-branded studies pay at 14 days; researcher-distributed incentives can have longer study-specific timelines (always shown before you apply).
when_cash_arrives: Most incentives are issued within a day or two of the completed session; researchers have up to 10 business days to release payment. UserTesting-branded studies pay via digital gift card 14 days after completion.
